title: Tens and Ones to 100
description: Build, read, draw, compare, and order two-digit numbers using tens, ones, and clear base-ten models.
learningFocus: Understand that ten ones make one ten, represent two-digit numbers as tens and ones, and compare two-digit numbers using >, <, and =.
adultGuidance: Let your child count the cubes in a ten-rod so the rod represents ten joined ones rather than only a long block. When comparing numbers, ask which has more tens first; compare the ones only when the tens are equal, and use the separate answer key for adult support.

seo.title: Tens and Ones to 100 Worksheets | Grade 1 Place Value
seo.description: Five printable Grade 1 place-value worksheets for building, drawing, comparing, and ordering two-digit numbers with tens and ones.
